lines: <pulse>Back</pulse> to shelving before someone comes looking for a book I moved.
I should return to the catalog and tidy up those notes.
There are pages that need stitching before they come loose.
<pulse>Back</pulse> to the back stacks. A missing index will not find itself.
I have stories to file and a new entry to write down.
The quiet at the desk is where I can think properly.
I promised to mend a binding before the sun sets.
I'll be back where the ink dries slower than gossip spreads.
Some records still need correcting before they confuse someone else.
The library is calling me back now.
